# Agoza (አጎዛ) - Ethiopia P2P Marketplace

## Site Overview
- **Name**: Agoza (አጎዛ)
- **Description**: Ethiopia's verified peer-to-peer e-commerce marketplace for smartphones, vehicles, laptops, real estate, and fashion with buyer protection.
- **URL**: https://anza.et
- **Language**: en, am
- **Region**: ET

## Core Pages
- `/` - Marketplace homepage with listings
- `/vault` - User's saved items
- `/user-dashboard` - User account management
- `/admin-dashboard` - Admin moderation
- `/plans` - Subscription plans

## Features
- Marketplace feed with filtering
- User vault/wishlist
- Trade offers and escrow
- Chat negotiation
- Safe Hubs (CBE in-person exchange)
- Plans & subscriptions
